# PYNK Studio Shot

Turn any product photo into a **clean studio product shot** — without writing a single prompt yourself.

## Setup

1. Open this folder in **Claude Code** (as its own project).
2. Type `/studio-shot` to start.

Nothing to install. The skill writes the **prompt**; you paste it into your image generator (built for GPT Image 2) with your photo attached.

## How it works

| Step | You do | You get |
|---|---|---|
| **1 · Your photo** | drop any photo of your product | the product read back to you |
| **2 · The look** | pick a background and format | locked in |
| **3 · The prompt** | nothing | the paste-ready prompt + what to attach |

Want your product in a scene instead? That is `/product-visuals`.
